title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Justin Thomas Boosts LivPur
items.text: Justin Thomas announced his hydration brand LivPur is now available in Target stores nationwide, expanding its reach before the 2027 PGA Tour season.

items.headline: Tiger Woods' Comeback Plans
items.text: Kevin Kisner shared that Tiger Woods aims to return to competition by December at the Hero World Challenge and play a full TGL schedule in 2027.

items.headline: Woods' Hero World Challenge Situation
items.text: Tiger Woods was left off the initial Hero World Challenge field, making his next move crucial for his comeback trajectory.
